violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Chef is certified through an approved food safety management course. Chef must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2026

Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the 2-door reach-in. Raw animal foods must be separated from (below) raw ready-to-eat food during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Potatoes were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
Spray bottle used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies was not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

The doors to the outside, located at the entrance, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2026

Utensils observed displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dishwasher. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2026

Soup observed thawing in stagnant water. Foods must be thawed under refrigeration, submerged under running water, or in the microwave just prior to cooking. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2025
Working container of flour observed not marked with common name of the food. Dry ingredients must be properly labeled. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024

The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit (rinse temperature 180 degrees F) was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Establishment must use 3-bay sink to sanitize until dishwasher is serviced and reaching proper sanitizing temperature. New Violation. Correct By: 10/14/2024

ROP salmon observed in the 2-door reach-in cold hold in its original package. ROP foods must be removed from the original package while thawing to ensure food safety. ROP salmon observed to have a temperature of 37 degrees F and was removed from packaging during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024
Refrigerator door gaskets of the 2-door reach-in were observed in poor repair, splitting away from the doors. Gaskets are to be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 11/07/2024
